title: Web Browser theme does not change with day/night mode despite day/night mode working well on main system.
line: Pages in the Web Browser widget now switch between light and dark as soon as the system colour scheme changes, without a reload.
explanation: QtWebEngine listens to QStyleHints::colorSchemeChanged and updates its web native theme, but it only copies that preference into a page's WebPreferences when its settings are applied, so an open page kept the scheme it was loaded with until it was reloaded. Kai's comment is right that Plasma reports the scheme correctly; the gap is in QtWebEngine. The widget now re-sets one of its WebEngine settings on Application.styleHints.colorSchemeChanged, which makes QtWebEngine re-apply its preferences and pages update their prefers-color-scheme live, with no reload and no lost page state.

commits.message:
applets/webbrowser: follow live light/dark switches on open pages

Pages kept the colour scheme they were loaded with, because QtWebEngine
only passes a new preferred colour scheme on once its settings are
applied again. Re-set a setting when the colour scheme changes.

BUG: 525234

patches.diff:
From baf0f70785783bfd7361211c65a5f0ed4d26ec32 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 04:36:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/webbrowser: follow live light/dark switches on open
 pages

Pages kept the colour scheme they were loaded with, because QtWebEngine
only passes a new preferred colour scheme on once its settings are
applied again. Re-set a setting when the colour scheme changes.

BUG: 525234
---
 applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml | 10 ++++++++++
 1 file changed, 10 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml b/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml
index 38c005eb0..41fb8efa4 100644
--- a/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/webbrowser/qml/main.qml
@@ -296,6 +296,16 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
                 readonly property bool useMinViewWidth : Plasmoid.configuration.useMinViewWidth
 
+                // QtWebEngine only hands a new light/dark preference to open pages when its
+                // settings are applied again; setting any of them does that.
+                Connections {
+                    target: Application.styleHints
+
+                    function onColorSchemeChanged() {
+                        webview.settings.javascriptCanAccessClipboard = true;
+                    }
+                }
+
                 Connections {
                     target: Plasmoid.configuration
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: page with a prefers-color-scheme rule in Breeze Light (left), then after switching to Breeze Dark (right): the toolbar turns dark but the page stays white.
With the fix: same page, same switch; the page turns black right away.

review.text: Clean, non-invasive workaround in applets/webbrowser for a confirmed upstream QtWebEngine gap where QStyleHints::colorSchemeChanged updates the native theme without re-applying WebPreferences to open pages. Triggering a settings re-apply on Application.styleHints.colorSchemeChanged updates prefers-color-scheme live without reloading or losing page state, and the before/after screenshots confirm it works cleanly. Minor non-blocking polish would be re-assigning the property to its current value instead of hardcoding true and linking an upstream Qt bug report in the comment once filed.
